name: Green Prismatic Poison
body:
DETAILS

Type poison, spell; Save Fort DC varies by spell; Frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; Cure 2 consecutive saves.

EFFECT

Initial Effect: Death

Secondary Effect: 1 Con damage

See prismatic sphere, prismatic spray, or prismatic wall for more details.
